purpose: Classify every strategy independently from Survivor promotion and preserve potentially useful synthesis material until marginal-combination evidence exists.

grades.S: A3-verified material. Highest grade; requires actual A3 durability evidence, never score-only inference.
grades.A: Strong standalone material awaiting or undergoing causal/A2/A3 hardening.
grades.B: Economically plausible material needing one-axis repair, commonly cost/turnover or risk-shape repair.
grades.C: Weak or sparse standalone evidence but structurally distinct enough to retain for bounded redesign/synthesis testing.
grades.D: Negative standalone material; synthesis-only pending marginal ablation, not automatically deleted.
grades.HOLD: Data/source/sample prevents a defensible material grade.

upgrade_policy.target: highest evidence-supported grade, never forced S

final_discard_gate.rule: DISCARD_CONFIRMED only when marginal net contribution is non-positive, drawdown improvement is non-positive, and behavior is redundant; otherwise retain as synthesis material.
